field_notes.attack_power / guarded_damage_negation /: Base values at +0 (Standard affinity) from the page infobox. Scaling grades: S > A > B > C > D > E, null = no scaling.
field_notes.skill.fp_cost: Wiki notation 'X (Y Z)': X = FP cost of the skill itself, Y/Z = FP cost of the light/heavy follow-ups. '-' = none.
field_notes.skill.type: 'Unique Skill' = exclusive skill (never sold as an Ash of War); 'Ash of War skill' = an 'Ash of War: <name>' item exists on the wiki; 'Standard skill (no Ash of War item)' = non-unique skill with no Ash of War item.
field_notes.passive_effects / status_buildup: Innate on-hit effects at +0 (status buildup values grow with upgrades for some weapons).
field_notes.upgrade.material: Smithing Stones => max +25; Somber Smithing Stones => max +10 and the weapon cannot take Ashes of War. null = the wiki page does not document it.
field_notes.upgrade.*_info_source: Where the value comes from: 'wiki (...)' = stated on the weapon page (template, text or upgrade table); 'deduced (...)' / 'game rule (...)' = strict logical consequence of what the page states.
field_notes.upgrade.estimate_if_undocumented: Only present when the wiki page does not document the upgrade path AND the documented examples of the same group (unique skill / other skill / catalyst) support at least medium confidence: statistical guess with its basis. Treat as unverified.
field_notes.upgrade.ash_of_war_changeable / affinity: true/false only when stated by the wiki (or implied by somber material); null = not documented.
field_notes.upgrade.tables: Per-affinity reinforcement data when the page provides it (levels '+N'; 'growth_per_level' = % growth per level as shown on the wiki). Scaling values: grade + coefficient when available. Coverage varies between pages.
field_notes.upgrade.tables_consistent_with_infobox: false = the page's upgrade table +0 physical attack differs from the infobox (wiki data inconsistency, prefer the infobox).
field_notes.regions_mentioned: Map regions detected in the acquisition text (helper for game-progression analysis).
field_notes.acquisition_flags: Heuristic tags derived from the acquisition text.
field_notes.notes / acquisition.details: Bullet text from the wiki; nested bullets are prefixed with '→' (one per nesting level).
field_notes.description / skill.description: English in-game descriptions (weapon page / skill page).
field_notes.skill.stamina_cost_wiki: Same 'X (Y Z)' notation as fp_cost, from the skill page.
field_notes.upgrade.buffable: Only present when the wiki states whether the weapon can be buffed (grease/spells).
field_notes.patch_notes: Balance changes listed on the weapon page: game version, official patch note, community explanation.
field_notes.compatible_ashes_of_war: Only on the few pages that list them.
field_notes.range: Bow/crossbow/ballista range as shown in the infobox (in-game 'Range' value).
field_notes.sorcery_scaling / incantation_scaling: Catalysts: base spell power at +0 from the infobox (Sorcery Scaling for staves, Incantation Scaling for seals).
field_notes.upgrade.tables.*.spell_buff: Catalysts: sorcery/incantation scaling at that upgrade level ('?' on the wiki => omitted).
field_notes.effects_details: Content of the page's 'Effects' section (e.g. which spells a seal boosts and by how much).

notes: Due to how enemy defense is calculated, this weapon will deal considerably more damage with Dwelling Arrows, Magicbone Arrows, Spiritflame Arrows, and Coldbone Arrows compared to other bows.

Like other bows, attribute scaling applies to both the bow's base damage as well as the base damage of the ammunition used. This bow is the only means of applying Intelligence-scaling to magic-infused arrows.
→ The greatest impact of this is that Magic damage-increasers such as Terra Magica can be applied to increase the damage of its shots and skills.
The Horn Bow has Intelligence-scaling which will never progress past an "E", even at +25. This effectively makes it a Strength/Dexterity weapon that deals minor Magic damage.
→ Effectively, Intelligence is useless beyond the bare minimum to wield this Bow and possibly for casting Terra Magica (12 Intelligence and 20 Intelligence respectively).
Has the second lowest Physical Attack Power of all Bows, a bit behind the Black Bow but far ahead of the Erdtree Bow.

patch_notes.community_notes: Added Intelligence scaling to the weapon. However, the scaling is very minor and never goes above an "E".

notes: This is by far the weakest Bow in terms of Physical Attack Power, at only about half the amount of the next weakest Bow (it is also weaker than all Light Bows in this stat).

Though the Holy Attack Power of this weapon scales with Faith it does not increase all that much with investment. The most important factor of that damage type is instead that the Erdtree Bow therefore benefits from Holy damage boosters such Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear and the Unique Skill: Last Rites, and that it is easier to meet the requirement of the universal Aura Buff Golden Vow to quite substantially increase its damage that way.
→ Note that this do not apply against other players due to a bug that prevents damage increases to work for Holy damage in PvP.

The "revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows" line refers to how this weapon uses Golden Arrows more effectively than other Bows due to both the Erdtree Bow's and Golden Arrow's Holy Attack Power stacking together.
→ Note that this is still affected by the targets Holy Damage Negation and that resistance to Holy is more common than resistance to Pierce in the base game.
→ The "Scales all arrow damage with faith" line meanwhile is not quite accurate as it is only the Holy Attack Power that scales with Faith, granting only minimal benefits with non-Holy Arrows.

→ The overlook to the Chariot is reached by dropping down a hole in the Grave's main path, and then afterwards in a room with a bridge the Tarnished will have to drop to the bottom of that room to then take an elevator to the overlook, guarded by a Dragon Communion-wielding Banished Knight.

Despite having a D scaling in Faith just like the Strength and Dexterity Attributes, the damage scales the best when leveling up Faith, albeit not by much.

→ Note that this is still affected by the targets Holy Damage Negation and that resistance to Holy is more common than resistance to Pierce in the base game.

→ As the difference in Holy Attack Power for a +10 Erdtree Greatbow at 14 Faith (minimum) and 99 Faith (maximum) is only 67 points (174 vs 241 Holy Attack Power), a Faith-focused build surprisingly enough only has roughly 24% more Holy Attack Power for the latter when accounting for the Golden Great Arrow's own 110 Holy Attack Power.

The Erdtree Greatbow has by far the lowest Attack Power out of all the Greatbows. Even with 99 in Strength, Dexterity and Faith, a +10 Erdtree Greatbow will only have a total Attack Power of 484, which is considerably lower than the Attack Power of a +25 Greatbow with the same stats (588 AR).

→ 40/40/40 will give the Erdtree Greatbow a total Attack Power of 414 (of which 206 is Holy).
→ 54/14/80 will give the Erdtree Greatbow a total Attack Power of 438 (of which 236 is Holy).

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug with using the weapon "Pulley Crossbow." When equipped with the left hand while the right hand weapon was given an attribute by magic or item, the effect was given to the "Pulley Crossbow" as well.

weapons.name: Astrologer's Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.

Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

details: Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin.
1x sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 Runes.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Consistently one of the stronger pure-Intelligence staff without an increased FP cost, with the most notable span being from 35 to 65 as it's only a few points of Sorcery Scaling behind the Academy Glintstone Staff at maximum upgrade level.

weapons.name: Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.

Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

details: Starting equipment for the Prisoner class.
Guaranteed drop from a Sorcerer Noble just south of Waypoint Ruins, just west of the graveyard with Wolves (one-time drop only).

acquisition.location: Limgrave/Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Altus Plateau/Consecrated Snowfield/Castle Ensis/Cerulean Coast
details: 2.04% drop chance from the Sorcerer variant Wandering Noble in the base game.

→ Some are found south of Waypoint Ruins, as well as in the caravan following the two Trolls pulling the carriage in Limgrave just east of Lake Agheel, and in the courtyard after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace/Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight.
2.00% drop chance from Sorcerer Nobles found in Castle Ensis and Cerulean Coast.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: A consistently mediocre staff with identical stats to the Carian Glintstone Staff (with the exception of the latter boosting the Attack Power of Carian Sword Sorceries), though it is decent from 35 to 65 Intelligence as it's only a few handful of points of Sorcery Scaling behind the Academy Glintstone Staff at maximum upgrade level.
At maximum upgrade level it has 126 Sorcery Scaling at 10 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 329 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.

→ Has 157 Sorcery Scaling at 20 Intelligence, 191 Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 224 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 257 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 291 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 310 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Academy Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone.

Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.

details: Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria just before the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace.
2% drop chance from Glintstone Sorcerers (excluding the Lazuli variant).

→ These Sorcerers are common enemies throughout Academy of Raya Lucaria, with 7 in particular being found on the way to the Red Wolf of Radagon from the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, along with a Lazuli Sorcerer and a Living Jar Warrior.
→ Two Sorcerers can be found just next to the Primeval Sorcerer Azur Site of Grace, just north of Hermit Village.
→ Several more can be found throughout Academy Crystal Cave and Sellia Hideaway.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: The strongest pure-Intelligence staff without an increased FP cost when Intelligence is between 41 and 68.
→ Demi-Human Queen's Staff is strongest from 10 to 41 Intelligence while Carian Regal Scepter is strongest from 68 to 99 Intelligence.
At maximum upgrade level it has 190 Sorcery Scaling at 28 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 345 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 233 Sorcery Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 268 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 304 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 325 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Digger's Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.

Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries.

details: 2% drop chance from regular and sack-carrying Glintstone Miners found in mines.
→ Plenty are found throughout the entirety of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, making it a good place to farm for it.
→ Sellia Crystal Tunnel is the earliest farming spot for the staff, though
→ Can also be found in Altus Tunnel and Sellia Hideaway.
4% drop chance from large Glintstone Miners.
→ One is found towards the end of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, another towards the end of Sellia Hideaway.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Boost's the Attack Power of the two Stonedigger Sorceries, Rock Blaster and Shatter Earth, by 20% when held (by 44% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Stonedigger Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Digger's Staff is held in the other hand.

A mediocre staff that's about 10% behind in Sorcery Scaling compared to the best staves, making it mediocre for anything but casting Stonedigger Sorceries (though from 50 Intelligence onwards it will only slightly outmatch the best Staff for casting these Sorceries, even when dual-wielding the Staff compared to the best Staff and a Digger's Staff).
At maximum upgrade level it has 129 Sorcery Scaling at 12 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 305 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.

→ Has 151 Sorcery Scaling at 20 Intelligence, 181 Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 211 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 241 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 271 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 288 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Demi-Human Queen's Staff
weapons.description:
Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence.

Sneered at by fools in the academy.

details: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen found in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: The strongest pure-Intelligence staff without an increased FP cost when Intelligence is between 10 and 41.
→ Academy Glintstone Staff is strongest from 41 to 68 Intelligence while Carian Regal Scepter is strongest from 68 to 99 Intelligence.
→ Note that the Meteorite Staff will still usually be better until the Demi-Human Queen's Staff is upgraded to +15-+18.
At maximum upgrade level it has 142 Sorcery Scaling at 10 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 291 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.

→ Has 190 Sorcery Scaling at 20 Intelligence, 212 Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 235 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 249 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 263 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 277 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.
An effective all-rounder of a staff with low requirements available early on. This staff is a reliable tool for Sorcery builds until they have the stats to specialize themselves.

weapons.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.

Reduces casting time of sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

details: Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

→ From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Glintstone Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops. Then, proceed further and go up the ladder at the end of said rooftops. After the sorcerer, go down on the rooftops again, until you can see a dome-like structure that has windows. Go through one of the windows, and descend onto the lower floor. One of the exits leads to a enclosed bridge, with a High Page guarding the secluded room. The staff is in the room behind him, in front of an inactive Graven Mass.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.
notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
Increases FP cost of Sorceries by 20%, in exchange for speeding up their casting time even more than the Radagon Icon (doesn't stack with another Azur's Glintstone Staff).
→ Casting speed is decreased for any spell cast when this staff is held in one of a character's two active hands, even if this staff isn't used to cast it.

→ Adds 40 "virtual" Dexterity for the purpose of improving casting speed. 70 Dexterity in total (both from the character's Dexterity and virtual Dexterity) is need to reach maximum casting speed, meaning it pairs well with the Radagon Icon's +30 virtual Dexterity on characters with a low amount in that stat.

→ The casting speed decrease applies to both Incantations and Sorceries but the FP cost increase only applies to Sorceries. This means that Incantation users can keep this Staff in the off-hand with no penalty aside from its weight and taking up an active hand-slot.
→ Wielding this Staff together with Lusat's Glintstone Staff increases FP cost by a total of 80%.
Has fairly good Sorcery Scaling at high levels of Intelligence, but the increased FP cost means it effectively has 83% FP-effectiveness compared to most other Staves
At maximum upgrade level it gains 254 Sorcery Scaling at 52 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 362 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 279 Sorcery Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 320 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Lusat's Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.

Enhances power of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

details: Found inside a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk boss fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: By far the strongest pure-Intelligence Staff, at the cost of increasing the FP cost of Sorceries by 50% when held.

→ Note that the increased FP cost also applies to Sorceries cast by other Staves if the Lusat's Glintstone Staff is held in the other active hand, whereas the high Sorcery Scaling is simply part of the Staff. This means that the Staff is purely detrimental when using other Staves.
→ Is the strongest Staff with the exception of a Prince of Death's Staff with very high levels of both Intelligence and Faith (75+).
→ Wielding this Staff together with Azur's Glintstone Staff increases FP cost by a total of 80%.

Though an extremely strong Staff, the increased FP cost means it effectively only has 67% FP-efficiency and is therefore most suited towards boss fights where the higher Attack Power per hit (11% higher compared to a Carian Regal Scepter with 80 Intelligence).
At maximum upgrade level it has 284 Sorcery Scaling at 52 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 413 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 314 Sorcery Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 364 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Carian Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.

Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.

details: Located in the regular version of Carian Study Hall, on a small pedestal just before the elevator to the second floor.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of the Carian Sword Sorceries sub-category (Adula's Moonblade, Carian Greatsword, Carian Piercer, and Carian Slicer) by 15% when held (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Carian Sword Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Carian Glintstone Staff is held in the other hand.

A consistently mediocre staff with identical stats to the Glintstone Staff (with the exception of also boosting the Attack Power of certain Sorceries), though it is decent from 35 to 65 Intelligence as it's only a few handful of points of Sorcery Scaling behind the Academy Glintstone Staff at maximum upgrade level and is fairly decent when casting Sword Sorceries.
At maximum upgrade level it has 171 Sorcery Scaling at 24 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 329 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 191 Sorcery Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 224 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 257 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 291 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 310 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Carian Glintblade Staff
weapons.description:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.

Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

details: Located on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, northeast of Laskyar Ruins and south of an Artist's Shack.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of the Carian Blade Sorceries sub-category (Carian Phalanx, Glintblade Phalanx, Glintblade Trio Shadow of the Erdtree, Greatblade Phalanx, Magic Downpour, and Magic Glintblade) by 15% when held (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Carian Blade Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Carian Glintblade Staff is held in the other hand.

A consistently mediocre staff, though it is decent from 35 to 65 Intelligence as it's only a few handful of points of Sorcery Scaling behind the Academy Glintstone Staff at maximum upgrade level and is fairly decent when casting Blade Sorceries.
At maximum upgrade level it has 166 Sorcery Scaling at 22 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 329 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 194 Sorcery Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 228 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 263 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 298 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 317 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Carian Regal Scepter

skill.name: Spinning Weapon
skill.description: Channel magic into the glintstone to suspend the scepter in mid air and cause it to spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive magic attacks.

weapons.description:
Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries.

Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of the Carian Moon Sorceries sub-category (Ranni's Dark Moon, Rellana's Twin Moons Shadow of the Erdtree, and Rennala's Full Moon) by +10% when held (by +21% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Carian Moon Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Carian Regal Scepter is held in the other hand.
The strongest pure-Intelligence staff without an increased FP cost when Intelligence is at 68 or above.
→ Demi-Human Queen's Staff is strongest from 10 to 41 Intelligence while Academy Glintstone Staff is strongest from 41 to 68 Intelligence.

Though this Staff ends up the strongest casting implement for Sorceries for a high Intelligence character, other Staves like the Astrologer's Staff or Crystal Staff might be more suitable initial options since the former is available much earlier and the latter has lower requirements while being equally easy to upgrade.

This Staff's Skill is a unique variant of Skill: Spinning Weapon, which instead of being quite weak on a Staff adds extra Magic Attack Power per hit that scales extremely well of the Staff's high base Intelligence-scaling to inflict high amounts of damage.
→ Though it's very visually obvious it's a strong anti-melee defense or weapon for when enemies have managed to approach past the caster's spells.
At maximum upgrade level it has 287 Sorcery Scaling at 60 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 373 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 330 Sorcery Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Albinauric Staff
weapons.description:
Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the Albinaurics of old.

The Albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery using their innate arcaneness.

details: Found together with the Albinauric Mask in the same room as an Omenkiller, located on the third floor of the same building as the Guest Hall Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor.
→ This room is accessed by jumping onto a balcony from the roof of the building. The balcony is located to the right of the building when looking towards the main entrance on the second floor.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: An interesting Staff, as it's the only one that scales with Arcane in the base game (Shadow of the Erdtree also adds the Maternal Staff). Despite it's seemingly Arcane-leaning Scaling, it actually performs best on a split Intelligence/Arcane build (325 Sorcery Scaling for a 45/45 hybrid build vs 297 Scaling for a pure 80 Arcane build).
Note that only the Intelligence portion of the Sorcery Scaling is used when casting Scholar's Armament, meaning that this Staff is rather unsuitable for that spell.
Increases the Blood Loss build-up inflicted by Sorceries, depending on how upgraded the Albinauric Staff is and the wielder's Arcane stat.
→ The maximum extra Status Effect build-up is a fifth of the Staff's current Arcane Scaling, meaning that with a +25 Staff's Arcane Scaling being 2.1 this caps at 42% (0.2*2.1=0.42).
→ Technically also increases the Madness, Poison, and Sleep inflicted by Sorceries, but none that inflict any of those Status Effects exists.
At maximum upgrade level it has 125 Sorcery Scaling at 10 Intelligence and 12 Arcane (minimum requirement) and 297 Sorcery Scaling at 10 Intelligence and 80 Intelligence.

→ Has 263 Sorcery Scaling at 10 Intelligence and 45 Arcane, 277 Scaling at 10 Intelligence and 60 Arcane, 297 Scaling at 10 Intelligence and 80 Arcane, 321 Scaling at 30 Intelligence and 60 Arcane, 325 Scaling at 45 Intelligence and 45 Arcane, and 373 Scaling at 80 Intelligence and 80 Arcane.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased the scaling of status effect build-up from spells and incantations of Albinauric Staff and Dragon Communion Seal.
patch_notes.community_notes: Previously the full Arcane-scaling applied to Status Effects for a possible 210% bonus to build-up, but this reduced it to 20% of that (for a maximum 42% bonus).

weapons.name: Staff of Loss
weapons.description:
Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism.

This staff only distinguishes itself when casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

details: Found on a corpse on a balcony in the northwestern parts of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, in eastern Caelid.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of two Night Sorceries (Night Comet and Night Shard) by 30% when held (by 69% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to these two Night Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Staff of Loss is held in the other hand.
→ Ambush Shard and Night Maiden's Mist aren't boosted by this staff, despite being damaging Night Sorceries.

An initially mediocre staff that gains a decent amount of Sorcery Scaling at higher (70+) levels of Intelligence, though it is always very strong when casting Night Comet and Night Shard (especially if two Staves of Loss can be acquired instead of using a single Staff of Loss to boost a stronger Staff).
At maximum upgrade level it has 134 Sorcery Scaling at 14 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 339 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.

→ Has 149 Sorcery Scaling at 20 Intelligence, 177 Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 206 Scaling at 40 Intelligence, 234 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 263 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, and 301 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
weapons.description:
Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.

The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

details: 11.11% drop chance from the egg-headed Man-Serpent near the throne in Volcano Manor, right before Rykard's teleporter at the end of the area.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Gelmir Sorceries (also known as Magma Sorceries) by 15% (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Gelmir Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Gelmir Glintstone Staff is held in the other hand.

One of the two Intelligence-Faith hybrid Staves in the base game, the Gelmir Glintstone Staff is the stronger alternative to the Prince of Death's Staff if both Intelligence and Faith are at 50 or below.

→ Shadow of the Erdtree adds the Staff of the Great Beyond, which outclasses the Gelmir Glintstone Staff as long as it is wieldable (i.e. both Intelligence and Faith are at least 25) and is stronger than the Prince of Death's Staff as long as both Intelligence and Faith are at 60 or below.
At maximum upgrade level it has 122 Sorcery Scaling at 14 Intelligence and 14 Faith (minimum requirement) and 280 Sorcery Scaling at 45 Intelligence and 45 Faith.

→ Has 220 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence and 14 Faith or 14 Intelligence and 80 Faith, 264 Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 30 Faith or 30 Intelligence and 60 Faith, 287 Scaling at 50 Intelligence and 50 Faith, 296 at 60 Intelligence and 60 Faith, and 318 at 80 Intelligence and 80 Faith.

weapons.name: Crystal Staff
weapons.description:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

The Crystalian's faint cogitation is known as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be wielded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

details: Found in a treasure chest inside Academy Crystal Cave. The chest is on a raised platform hidden by an illusory wall, which in turn is found to the left just after the door to the room with the Battlemage/fog wall to the boss.
→ Entering the cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki rule (Ashes of War cannot be applied to weapons upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones)
upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Crystalian Sorceries by 10% (by 21% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Crystalian Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Crystal Staff is held in the other hand.
→ This bonus stacks with the one from a Rotten Crystal Staff, making this one of a few Staves that can stack the Spell boost without starting another Journey or trading with another player.

A decent replacement for the Carian Regal Scepter for high-Intelligence characters who do not wish to fight Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon as it only has 1.5% less Sorcery Scaling, and also has somewhat lower requirements if one is looking for an easy-to-upgrade Staff since it needs Somber Smithing Stones.
At maximum upgrade level it has 244 Sorcery Scaling at 48 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 367 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 283 Sorcery Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 325 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
weapons.description:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.

Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

details: 8% drop chance from Putrid Crystalian Mage enemies such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Crystalian Sorceries by 10% (by 21% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Crystalian Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Rotten Crystal Staff is held in the other hand.
→ This bonus stacks with the one from a Crystal Staff, making this one of a few Staves that can stack the Spell boost without starting another Journey or trading with another player.
Essentially a slightly weaker version of the Crystal Staff, giving up 1-2 points of Sorcery Scaling in exchange for Scarlet Rot build-up on its melee attacks.
→ Do note that this is essentially just a weaker Crystal Staff with a nearly useless benefit, its greatest use is as a stat stick for those wishing to maximize the power of Crystalian Sorceries.
At maximum upgrade level it has 243 Sorcery Scaling at 48 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 365 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ Has 281 Sorcery Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 323 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Meteorite Staff
weapons.description:
Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.

However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

details: Found inside a broken tower with Miranda Sprouts in the southwestern part of Street of Sages Ruins, in the northwestern corner of the Swamp of Aeonia.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.
notes: This weapon can't be upgraded at all.
This weapon can't be buffed or infused with Ashes of War.
Though it is unupgradeable, it's effectively equivalent to a +15 Regular or +5 Somber Staff.
→ Useful early on for anything wishing to delve into Sorceries, especially if grabbed as soon as the playthrough starts.

→ Easily reachable by taking the teleport chest in Dragon-Burnt Ruins to get to Sellia Crystal Tunnel and exiting it down the hill (remember to rest at the Site of Grace to unlock regular teleportation again). From there, just head west in the swamp.
Has a Strength requirement of 6, below the minimum possible Strength for any of the Origins.
Increases the Attack Power of Gravity Sorceries by 30% (by 69% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Gravity Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Meteorite Staff is held in the other hand.
Usable as a staff if casting Gravity Sorceries, but is otherwise best used as an off-hand stat stick to boost the power of specific spells after another staff has been sufficiently upgraded.
138 Sorcery Scaling at 18 Intelligence (minimum requirement) and 272 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence.
→ 168 Scaling at 30 Intelligence, 193 Scaling with 40 Intelligence, 218 Scaling at 50 Intelligence, 244 Scaling at 60 Intelligence, 258 Scaling at 70 Intelligence.

weapons.name: Staff of the Guilty
weapons.description:
A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic.

Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when wielding this staff which enhances thorn sorceries in particular.

acquisition.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: 2% drop chance from Guilty, aka Thorn-Fire Sorcerers.

→ The earliest place to find them is around the Fire Monk camp just north of the Artist's Shack in eastern Liurnia, while alternative farming spots is Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir and Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of both Bloodthorn Sorceries and Impenetrable Thorn Sorceries Shadow of the Erdtree by 20% (by 44% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Thorn Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Staff of the Guilty is held in the other hand.

→ Do note that using an Albinauric Staff or Maternal Staff Shadow of the Erdtree may be more wellsuited for those spells, as they can somewhat increase the Blood Loss build-up with their Arcane-scaling.

A decent implement for Sorceries for a build with high Faith, though Intelligence will still be needed to be able to cast those Sorceries and the low Sorcery Scaling means that Incantations will most likely still be significantly stronger.
Since only the Intelligence portion of Sorcery Scaling is used for Scholar's Armament, that spell will be extremely weak if cast using this Staff.

This Staff's innate Blood Loss build-up technically makes it the Staff best suited for the Ash of War-variant of Skill: Spinning Weapon, but since that build-up will still be low and all Staves have near useless Attack Power this is pretty much entirely a worthless novelty.
At maximum upgrade level it has 129 Sorcery Scaling at 12 Faith (minimum requirement) and 305 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Faith.
→ Has 151 Sorcery Scaling at 20 Faith, 181 Scaling at 30 Faith, 211 Scaling at 40 Faith, 241 Scaling at 50 Faith, 271 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 288 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.name: Prince of Death's Staff
weapons.description:
Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries.

One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

details: Found on top of a building reached by running up the roots northeast of The Nameless Eternal City grace.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Death Sorceries (except for Rings of Spectral Light Shadow of the Erdtree, Mass of Putrescence Shadow of the Erdtree, and Vortex of Putrescence Shadow of the Erdtree) by 10% (by 21% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Death Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Prince of Death's Staff is held in the other hand.
Potentially the strongest Staff in the game, stronger than even Lusat's Glintstone Staff when both Intelligence and Faith is above 75.
One of the two Intelligence-Faith hybrid Staves in the base game, the Prince of Death's Staff is the stronger alternative to the Gelmir Glintstone Staff if both Intelligence and Faith is above 50.

→ Shadow of the Erdtree adds the Staff of the Great Beyond, which outclasses the Gelmir Glintstone Staff as long as it is wieldable (i.e. both Intelligence and Faith is least 25) and is stronger than the Prince of Death's Staff as long as both Intelligence and Faith is at 60 or below.
At maximum upgrade level it has 161 Sorcery Scaling at 18 Intelligence and 18 Faith (minimum requirement) and 266 Sorcery Scaling at 45 Intelligence and 45 Faith.

→ Has 296 Sorcery Scaling at 80 Intelligence and 18 Faith or 18 Intelligence and 80 Faith, 266 Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 30 Faith or 30 Intelligence and 60 Faith, 286 Scaling at 50 Intelligence and 50 Faith, 326 at 60 Intelligence and 60 Faith, and 430 at 80 Intelligence and 80 Faith.

weapons.name: Maternal Staff
weapons.description:
Staff of Count Ymir, who made himself a Mother of Fingers.
Carried for want of tail-fingers of his own.
Enhances finger sorceries.

The crystal ball, though representative of a microcosm, would not receive any sign.

details: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after having slain Metyr, Mother of Fingers.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Finger Sorceries by 15% (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Finger Sorceries cast with other Staves, as long as a Maternal Staff is held in the other hand.

Together with the Albinauric Staff this is one of only two Arcane-scaling Staves. Despite its seemingly evenly split Scaling, it actually initially performs best when one of Intelligence or Arcane is focused on (257 Sorcery Scaling for a 45/45 hybrid build vs 266 Scaling for a pure 70/21 hybrid build).
→ Compared to the Albinauric Staff this Staff performs better at higher levels, where it's better Scaling can be taken advantage of.
Note that only the Intelligence portion of the Sorcery Scaling is used when casting Scholar's Armament, meaning that this Staff is rather unsuited for that spell.
Increases the Blood Loss build-up inflicted by Sorceries, depending on how upgraded the Maternal Staff is and the wielder's Arcane stat.
→ The maximum extra Status Effect build-up is a fifth of the Staff's current Arcane Scaling, meaning that with a +25 Staff's Arcane Scaling being 1.65 this caps at 33% (0.2*1.65=0.33).
→ Technically also increases the Madness, Poison, and Sleep inflicted by Sorceries, but none that inflict any of those Status Effects exists.
At maximum upgrade level it has 168 Sorcery Scaling at 21 Intelligence and 21 Arcane (minimum requirement) and 291 Sorcery Scaling at 21 Intelligence and 80 Arcane or 80 Intelligence and 21 Arcane.
→ Has 257 Sorcery Scaling at 30 Intelligence and 60 Arcane or 60 Intelligence and 30 Arcane, 314 Scaling at 60 Intelligence and 60 Arcane, and 413 Scaling at 80 Intelligence and 80 Arcane.

weapons.name: Staff of the Great Beyond
passive_effects: Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations
weapons.description:
Staff fashioned from the tail-fingers of Metyr, the Mother of Fingers, and the microcosm raised aloft over the crux they form. Catalyst for casting both sorceries and incantations.

The Mother received signs from the Greater Will from the beyond of the microcosm. Despite being broken and abandoned, she kept waiting for another message to come.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Staves only have one compatible Ash of War, the Ash of War: Spinning Weapon, though they aren't a very fitting match for that one's skill.

notes: This Staff can cast both Sorceries and Incantations, the only Catalyst that can do so.

→ Note that, as usual, Scholar's Armament will only scale with the Intelligence-portion of the scaling while Incantation Weapon Buffs and direct healing spells only scale with the Faith-based portion.
One of the three Intelligence-Faith hybrid staves in the game, and the strongest one when both Intelligence and Faith are at least 25 but less than 60.
→ When Intelligence and Faith are greater than 60, the Prince of Death's Staff has a higher sorcery scaling.
→ Always outperforms the Gelmir Glintstone Staff when Intelligence & Faith requirements are met.
At maximum upgrade level it has 210 Sorcery Scaling at 25 Intelligence and 25 Faith (minimum requirement) and 309 Sorcery Scaling at 45 Intelligence and 45 Faith.

→ Has 259 Sorcery Scaling at 25 Intelligence and 45 Faith or 45 Intelligence and 25 Faith, 272 Scaling at 25 Intelligence and 65 Faith or 65 Intelligence and 25 Faith, 281 Scaling at 25 Intelligence and 80 Faith or 80 Intelligence and 25 Faith, 327 at 60 Intelligence and 60 Faith, and 352 at 80 Intelligence and 80 Faith.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug where casting the Inescapable Frenzy Incantation using the Staff of the Great Beyond would cause its hitbox to be generated incorrectly.
patch_notes.community_notes: The bug caused the spell to deal no damage if the grab landed.

weapons.name: Finger Seal
weapons.description:
A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations.

Incantations must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

details: Part of the starting equipment for the Prophet and Confessor Origins.
Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 800 Runes.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.
notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.

At 249% Faith scaling this Seal is technically the third strongest in the game, and the strongest if your Faith is between 10 and 26. Do note that it is outclassed by any Sacred Seal with a bonus to certain spells if those spells are being cast.

→ Consistently 3-5 points behind the Godslayer's Seal after reaching 27 Faith and above, making it quite viable to keep the Finger Seal upgraded for regular use if you have already invested in it and are somewhat lacking in regular Smithing Stones.

→ Actually stronger than the Erdtree Seal until 66 Faith, and thereafter it becomes outclassed, which in combination with the latter requiring the much more common Somber Smithing Stones makes the latter option much more favorable.
No bonus to any incantations, not even the ones granted by the Two Fingers, a trait shared only with the Erdtree Seal among the sacred seals.
At maximum upgrade level it has 126 Incantation Scaling at 10 Faith (minimum requirement) and 324 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.
→ Has 156 Incantation Scaling at 20 Faith, 188 Scaling at 30 Faith, 221 Scaling at 40 Faith, 254 Scaling at 50 Faith, 286 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 305 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.name: Erdtree Seal
weapons.description:
A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.

Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.

details: Found inside a open cell just northwest of the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is an Omenkiller enemy near it.

→ Can also be found by starting at the Guest Hall Site of Grace and backtracking to the top floor of the building, before exiting it across the bridge and taking a right through the large gate to find a bonfire. The Seal is in one of the cells there.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.
notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
Does NOT increase the damage of Erdtree Incantations, despite the name and association with that incantation type.
The strongest Faith-only Sacred Seal when the stat is above 68.
→ Gets 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith when the seal is at +10. The other seals are in the 310 to 330 range at that point.

→ If using only a single Seal, other Faith-only Seals will still outmatch the Erdtree Seal when using the type of incantations that they boost. However, since this boost also applies to other Seals when a spell-boosting seal is held in an active hand, wielding two Seals at the same time makes the Erdtree Seal once again the stronger alternative unless two copies of the same spell-boosting seal are obtained.

Though it won't quite catch up with the Godslayer's Seal (the strongest Seal beforehand) until the Faith stat reaches the 60s, the ease of upgrading it because it requires Somber Smithing Stones (versus the unfortunately generally much rarer Smithing Stones that the Godslayer's Seal needs) means it can still see good use beforehand.
Besides increasing the Seal's Incantation Scaling, the Faith-scaling also increases the its own meager base Physical and Holy damage.
At maximum upgrade level it has 212 Incantation Scaling at 40 Faith (minimum requirement) and 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.
→ Has 243 Incantation Scaling at 50 Faith, 273 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 313 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.name: Golden Order Seal
weapons.description:
A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Order Fundamentalist incantations.

Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantations using both intelligence and faith.

details: Found at the tree inside of the Minor Erdtree Church, southwest of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki rule (Ashes of War cannot be applied to weapons upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones) + wiki (class page: Sacred Seals)
upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.
notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Increases the Attack Power of Golden Order Incantations (except for Law of Causality and Order's Blade) by 10% (by 21% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Golden Order Incantations cast with other Seals, as long as a Golden Order Seal is held in the other hand.
→ The boost for Discus of Light, Radagon's Rings of Light, and Triple Rings of Light stacks with the Dryleaf Seal's 15% boost.
→ Multilayered Ring of Light is not a Golden Order Incantation, and as such is NOT boosted by the Golden Order Seal.
Only the Faith portion of its scaling applies to Healing and Weapon Buff incantations, most notably making it rather unsuitable for casting Order's Blade.
→ The strongest faith scaling of the hybrid seals at 159%, though that is barely over half of the Faith-only Seals (averaging 250%).
Like most of the weightless seals, it lacks a Strength scaling for its Physical damage.
Scales best with an equal split of Intelligence and Faith.
→ A 17/17 split (minimum requirements) gives 150 Incantation Scaling.
→ A 45/17 or 17/45 split (reaching one middle softcap) gives 244 Incantation Scaling.
→ A 80/17 or 17/80 split (reaching one of the highest softcaps) gives 270 Incantation Scaling.
→ A 45/45 split (reaching both middle softcaps) gives 338 Incantation Scaling, comparable to an Erdtree Seal gaining 353 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.

For casting Incantations with a faith requirement below 17, the Frenzied Flame Seal is potentially better due to much lower Attribute requirements (none at all) but is attainable only later, and requires completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline and at least partially committing to her Ending.

weapons.name: Dryleaf Seal
passive_effects: Boosts golden ring of light incantations
weapons.description:
Sacred seal of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Enhances incantations of Miquella.

Those who saw the decline of the Erdtree in the fallen leaves long ago braced themselves for the weakening of Order, and embraced a strict faith. And then, they made to serve a new god.

details: Found on one of the cliffs facing the river north of Recluses' River Downstream site of grace.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of ring-based Incantations (mainly the Golden Order Incantations Discus of Light, Radagon's Rings of Light, and Triple Rings of Light, but also Multilayered Ring of Light) by 15% (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to these Incantations when cast with other Seals, as long as a Dryleaf Seal is held in the other hand.

The strongest pure-Faith Seal between 27 and 50 Faith, outclassing the Godslayer's Seal in this span.
A somewhat mediocre Seal, mainly useful as an off-hand stat stick to strengthen certain Incantations.

weapons.description:
Sacred seal of the Fire Knights, who answer directly to Messmer the Impaler.

Enhances fire incantations of Messmer.

The emblem of Messmer's army depicts a golden ring and the fire of his sacred seal.

details: After draining the water from the district, this item can be found on the floor behind the decapitated statue of Marika inside the largest church in the district. It is guarded by Wego, Fire Knight Elder along with his putrid corpse summons.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

Has surprisingly backloaded Scaling, improving a surprising amount per point of Faith from 60 to 80.
A somewhat mediocre Seal, mainly useful as an off-hand stat stick to strengthen certain Incantations or to cast those specific Incantations with just one seal.

weapons.name: Spiraltree Seal
weapons.description:
Sacred seal of soiled amber engraved with a spiral tree design.

Enhances spiral incantations.

The majesty of the white tower, stretching to reach the gods, even inspired a secret faith in the invaders, the people of the Erdtree.

details: Reward from "The Sacred Tower" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with a painting found in a cave, northeast of the Scorched Ruins.

→ The player can only acquire this item after having burned the sealing tree past the Church of the Bud. After which the painter (and thus this item) can be found on the edge of a cliff south of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Spiral Incantations by 20% (by 44% if one is held in each hand).

Somewhat decent as a Seal for low levels of Faith, where it's only somewhat behind the Finger Seal, but it falls behind further and further, mainly useful as an off-hand stat stick to strengthen certain Incantations.

→ Has 181 Incantation Scaling at 30 Faith, 211 Scaling at 40 Faith, 241 Scaling at 50 Faith, 271 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 288 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.description:
Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital.

The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold.

details: Dropped by a specific spear-wielding Leyndell Knight, found just to the left when standing outside of the front gate to the Fortified Manor.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Dragon Cult Incantations (except for Electrify Armament) by 15% (by 32.25% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to Dragon Cult Incantations cast with other Seals, as long as a Gravel Stone Seal is held in the other hand.
Consistently only a few points behind the currently strongest pure Faith Sacred Seal until the low 70's, where the Erdtree Seal begins to greatly out-scale all other Seals.
→ If only one Seal is wielded, this Seal is always the strongest one for the purpose of casting damage-dealing Dragon Cult Incantations due to its damage boost.

→ Has 186 Incantation Scaling at 30 Faith, 218 Scaling at 40 Faith, 250 Scaling at 50 Faith, 282 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 300 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.name: Giant's Seal
weapons.description:
Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair.

Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giant's Flame incantations.

details: Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, reached by taking an elevator down and then sending it up again, then pulling the elevator's lever to ride down another floor using a hidden compartment and then finally climbing up a ladder to the left to find the room.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Giants' Flame Incantations (except for Catch Flame, Fire's Deadly Sin, and Flame Sling) by 20% (by 44% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to these Incantations when cast with other Seals, as long as a Giant's Seal is held in the other hand.

weapons.name: Godslayer's Seal
weapons.japanese_name: 神狩りの聖印 (Kami Kari no Hijiri Shirushi)
weapons.description:
Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian.

Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

details: Found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left in the castle courtyard (the one just before the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace) if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by four rats.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Godslayer Incantations (except for Black Flame Blade and Noble Presence) by 10% (by 21% if one is held in each hand).

The strongest pure-Faith Seal between 27 and 68 Faith, outclassed by the Finger Seal before that and the Erdtree Seal afterwards.
→ The Dryleaf Seal is stronger from 27 to 50 Faith, but is only available in the DLC.

A very strong Seal and always the strongest for casting Godslayer Incantations if only one Seal can be held, but the Erdtree Seal eventually getting stronger and being much easier to upgrade makes it strong competition if one is planning to level Faith to 40 or above.
At maximum upgrade level it has 181 Incantation Scaling at 27 Faith (minimum requirement) and 329 Incantation Scaling at 80 Faith.
→ Has 224 Incantation Scaling at 40 Faith, 257 Scaling at 50 Faith, 291 Scaling at 60 Faith, and 310 Scaling at 70 Faith.

weapons.name: Clawmark Seal
weapons.description:
Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantions to be scaled with strength.

The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

details: Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.
notes: Upgraded with Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The Incant Scaling is based off of the minimum Faith and Strength required to wield the seal.

effects_details: Used to cast Incantations. Boosts the effectiveness of damaging Bestial Incantations by 10%.
notes: Unique to the other sacred seals, the Clawmark Seal scales with both Faith and Strength. Both stats will have a B scaling at +25.
→ Due to its Strength scaling, it also benefits greatly from two-handing since Incantations will receive the same 50% Strength bonus that comes with two-handing weapons.

The Clawmark Seal is best suited for high-Strength, low-to-mid-Faith builds. At higher levels of Faith, the other sacred seals will outperform the Clawmark Seal in terms of raw damage despite its 10% damage boost to Bestial Incantations.
Healing and weapon buff Incantations will only benefit from the Faith scaling, not Strength.
The Clawmark Seal stacks multiplicatively with the Cinquedea, bringing the damage boost to 21%.
→ This stacking is also possible with two Clawmark Seals.
→ The 10% boost is also granted to Bestial Incantations cast with other Sacred Seals, as long as a Clawmark Seal or Cinquedea is held in the other hand.
At maximum upgrade level it has 115 Incantation Scaling (119 when two-handed) at 10 Strength and 10 Faith, and 280 Incantation Scaling (292 when two-handed) at 45 Strength and 45 Faith.

→ Has 217 Incantation Scaling (238 and 221 respectively when two-handed) at 80 Strength and 10 Faith or 10 Strength and 80 Faith, 264 Scaling (281 and 290 respectively when two-handed) at 60 Strength and 30 Faith or 30 Strength and 60 Faith, 296 Scaling (314 when two-handed) at 60 Strength and 60 Faith, and 318 Scaling (341 when two-handed) at 80 Strength and 80 Faith.

weapons.name: Frenzied Flame Seal
weapons.description:
Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame.

This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence and faith all together.

details: Received by completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline by accepting the blessing of the Three Fingers and then touching her.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

notes: Increases the Attack Power of Frenzied Flame Incantations by 20% (by 44% if one is held in each hand).
→ Also applies to these Incantations when cast with other Seals, as long as a Frenzied Flame Seal is held in the other hand.

The main upside of the Frenzied Flame Seal is that it has no requirements to wield and is weightless, making it useful for casting Law of Regression on a build with high Intelligence but no Faith. It's also the only Sacred Seal that scales with Dexterity.
→ Since Faith is the strongest scaling stat, leveling the other three stats do not provide big benefits.

→ Note that though it's Incantation Scaling scales with all four of Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith, it's low scaling in all means it doesn't stand out unless only Faith is low among those stats, as the Godslayer's Seal and Erdtree Seal will strongly outmatch it with a decent amount of Faith, and the Golden Order Seal will quickly start to catch up at high Intelligence as long as its minimum Faith requirement is met.
The Madness from the Seal is only applied to its melee attacks.
At maximum upgrade level it has 119 Incantation Scaling with Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith at 10, and 373 Incantation Scaling with Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith at 80.

→ Has 170 Incantation Scaling with only one of the non-Faith stats at 80 and the others at 10, 201 Scaling with two of the non-Faith stats at 45 and the other two at 10, 221 Scaling with only Faith at 80 and the others at 10, 242 Scaling with Faith and one of the non-Faith stats at 45 and the other two at 10, and 325 Scaling with all four stats at 45, 271 Scaling with Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence at 80.

weapons.name: Dragon Communion Seal
weapons.description:
Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations.

The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power. Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate. This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.

details: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the end of the ramp and is quite tough for the early game. The Chariot in the dungeon can be used to help kill it, though that comes at considerable risk to the player as well.

upgrade.class_ash_of_war_rule: Sacred Seals are not compatible with any Ashes of War.

effects_details: Used to cast Incantations. Boosts the effectiveness of Dragon Communion Incantations by 15%.
→ Bayle's Flame Lightning Shadow of the Erdtree
→ Bayle's Tyranny Shadow of the Erdtree
→ Ghostflame Breath Shadow of the Erdtree
notes: This Sacred Seal is best used for split Arcane/Faith builds, with an even split being slightly more favorable over one more biased towards Arcane. It can also be used for a pure Arcane build but that alternative is slightly weaker, by about 7-8%.
→ For comparison: a 45/45 Arc/Fth split gives 336 Scaling at +10, a 60/30 Arc/Fth split gives 333 Scaling at +10, and a 80/10 Arc/Fth split gives 310 Scaling at +10.
Holding a DCS in each active hand (that is, two Seals that are each held in separate hands) will increase the Attack Power boost to Dragon Communion Incantations to 32.25% (1.15*1.15=1.3225).
→ The damage boost is still granted if the other piece of equipment is two-handed.
→ This bonus stacks with the 20% damage boost granted when reactivating the Rock Heart.

Any incantation that inflicts Poison (except for Poison Armament), Madness, or non-bloodflame Blood Loss build-up and is cast using this Seal will have their Status Effect scale with the wielder's Arcane stat.

→ This status build-up bonus is equivalent to a fifth of the regular Weapon Scaling bonus from Stat Scaling, meaning that with a +10 DCS's scaling with Arcane being at 2.25 this caps at 45% (0.2*2.25=0.45).

→ Of the Blood Loss-inflicting incantations only Swarm of Flies inflicts any direct Blood Loss-build up (70 build-up out of its total 150 build-up) as direct status build-up instead of as part of a non-scaling bloodflame effect.
→ It would theoretically also scale the amount of Sleep build-up of any incantation that inflicts such a Status Effect. However, no incantation that inflicts that status effect exists.
→ Curiously Scarlet Rot build-up doesn't scale with Arcane, even though the spell type can inflict that status effect.

The weight being 0 and the existence of Physical Dragon Communion Incantations such as Dragonmaw and Rotten Breath means this Seal works well with the Blue Dancer Charm's weight-based increase to Physical damage.
→ This synergy is further enhanced by the existence of the Rock Heart, essentially a 0 weight armor set that can increase the damage of Dragon Communion Incantations even further.

This Seal is very unsuitable for casting Weapon Buff or direct healing spells as those depend entirely on the Faith portion of the used Seal's scaling, and this Seal only have about a third of the Faith scaling that pure Faith scaling Seals such as the Finger Seal and Erdtree Seal have.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased the scaling of status effect build-up from spells and incantations of Albinauric Staff and Dragon Communion Seal.
patch_notes.community_notes: Previously both of these casting implements full Arcane-scaling would apply to the Status Effects build-up of spells cast with them. For a +10 Dragon Communion Seal, this meant that almost the full S (2.25) would be applied thus resulting in roughly 3 times the Status Effect build-up on builds with high Arcane which would often result in instant or near instant application of Madness with spells such as Frenzied Burst.
